verification.command:
env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ./.venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import copy, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.research import companion_installer as install
from scripts.research import companion_runtime_adapter as adapter
from scripts.research import companion_network_configuration as network
from scripts.research import companion_install_env as env
from scripts.research import companion_metadata_diagnostics as diag
root = Path.cwd()
base = root / "docs/review_artifacts/companion_continuation_20261021"
diagnostic_raw = (base / "staged_metadata_diagnostic.json").read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(diagnostic_raw).hexdigest() == "03ffaa2dd4e4ee3c6d42383c41df4e04c3e797382416699134aa9661e3bf748e"
d = json.loads(diagnostic_raw)
manifest_raw = (root / "docs/review_artifacts/companion_continuation_20261020/reviewed_preparation_manifest.json").read_bytes()
manifest_sha = hashlib.sha256(manifest_raw).hexdigest()
assert manifest_sha == "3b6f785ca1dd732e307aa83b30dcea2a5d2d9379d57af06a4afaa3774df94635" == d["manifest_sha256"]
plan = install.Plan.load(manifest_raw, manifest_sha)
evidence_raw = (root / ".cbp_state/runtime/companion_preparations" / plan.attempt / "evidence.json").read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(evidence_raw).hexdigest() == "78726c0b834778934368713e55a7496a91249d17323e3d43c9052895a5e4d8de" == d["evidence_sha256"]
e = json.loads(evidence_raw)
capture_raw = (root / "docs/review_artifacts/companion_continuation_20261020/fresh_v5_capture_20261020/capture.json").read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(capture_raw).hexdigest() == "0fa450f65997a8ace714babc6b514270eab308cd22f623a6e06177ab3c09fa1b"
originals = {r["name"].removeprefix("/"): r for r in json.loads(capture_raw)["observations"]}
actuals = {r["id"]: r for r in d["rows"]}
comparisons = {r["name"]: r for r in d["comparisons"]}
assert len(actuals) == len(d["rows"]) == len(comparisons) == 4
bindings = dict(plan.network_bindings)
result = []
for app, saved in zip(plan.applications, e["replacements"]):
    row = actuals[saved["id"]]
    assert row["name"].removeprefix("/") == saved["name"] == plan.staged_name(app["name"])
    assert row["image"] == saved["image"] and row["attempt"] == saved["attempt"] == plan.attempt
    assert row["state"] == "created" and row["started"] == "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    assert row["restarts"] == 0 and row["restart_policy"] == "no"
    assert adapter.preservation_digest(row) == saved["metadata"]
    assert adapter.preservation_digest({**row, "networks": {}}) == saved["foundation"]
    digest, ids, evidence = network.project(row, bindings)
    assert digest == saved["configured_metadata"]
    assert list(ids) == saved["configured_networks"] and [list(x) for x in evidence] == saved["network_evidence"]
    expected = copy.deepcopy(originals[app["name"]])
    flags = [dict(f) for f in expected["flags"] if f is not None]
    present = set()
    for f in flags:
        if f["key"] in env._OVERRIDES: f["ok"] = True
        present.add(f["key"])
    flags.extend({"key": k, "ok": True} for k in env._OVERRIDES if k not in present)
    expected["flags"] = [*flags, None]
    expected_digest = network.project(expected, bindings)[0]
    assert expected_digest == app["replacement_configured_metadata"]
    assert row["extra_hosts"] is None and row["dns"] is None
    assert expected["extra_hosts"] == expected["dns"] == []
    assert row["flags"] == expected["flags"]
    field_matches = {}
    for field in diag.FIELDS:
        forward = {**expected, field: row.get(field)}
        reverse = {**row, field: expected.get(field)}
        field_matches[field] = network.project(forward, bindings)[0] == expected_digest and network.project(reverse, bindings)[0] == digest
    false_fields = sorted(k for k, ok in field_matches.items() if not ok)
    assert false_fields == ["dns", "extra_hosts", "networks"]
    assert comparisons[app["name"]]["comparison"]["fields"] == field_matches
    assert comparisons[app["name"]]["comparison"]["aggregate_matches"] is False
    assert comparisons[app["name"]]["comparison"]["flags_order_only"] is False
    assert comparisons[app["name"]]["comparison"]["interaction_unresolved"] is False
    assert comparisons[app["name"]]["flag_multisets_equal"] is True
    patched = copy.deepcopy(row)
    patched["extra_hosts"] = []; patched["dns"] = []
    aliases = app["network_options"][1::2]
    assert app["network_options"][::2] == ["--alias"] * len(aliases) and len(patched["networks"]) == 1
    for net in patched["networks"].values(): net["Aliases"] = aliases
    assert {k for k in row if row[k] != patched[k]} == {"extra_hosts", "dns", "networks"}
    for name in row["networks"]:
        assert {k for k in row["networks"][name] if row["networks"][name][k] != patched["networks"][name][k]} == {"Aliases"}
    assert network.project(patched, bindings)[0] == expected_digest
    aliases_only = copy.deepcopy(row)
    for net in aliases_only["networks"].values(): net["Aliases"] = aliases
    assert network.project(aliases_only, bindings)[0] != expected_digest
    for omitted_field in ("dns", "extra_hosts", "networks"):
        partial = copy.deepcopy(patched); partial[omitted_field] = copy.deepcopy(row[omitted_field])
        assert network.project(partial, bindings)[0] != expected_digest
    result.append({"name": app["name"], "id": row["id"], "actual_digest": digest, "expected_final_digest": expected_digest, "differing_gate_fields": false_fields, "flags_exactly_equal_including_order": True, "two_empty_fields_plus_aliases_reproduce_expected": True, "aliases_only_insufficient": True})
print(json.dumps({"checks": "PASS", "rows": result, "native_operations": False, "only_offline_clones_modified": True}, sort_keys=True))
PY
